name: Summoning Shadra
summary: At Shadra'Alor, you read Master Gadrin's parchment and call Shadra from the Witherbark realm.

sections.title: Call of the Spider God
sections.body: Master Gadrin sends you deep into the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands. At Shadra'Alor, you read his parchment at the altar, and Shadra the spider god answers. Defeat her there, then carry her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Who provides the parchment to summon Shadra?
faq.answer: Master Gadrin gives you the parchment.
You summon Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep in the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who receives the venom once Shadra is defeated?
aliases: who do i turn the venom into
faq.answer: After Shadra is defeated, you take her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
